# Technologies
There's no separate tier or discipline system to track anymore - every technology lives inside one of the five branches on the [textlink="R&D Console" link="Science"], each its own independent node tree.
Unlocking a node in [color=#3B82F6]Medical[/color], [color=#14B8A6]Logistics[/color], [color=#F59E0B]Engineering[/color], or [color=#9A6EF0]Research[/color] prints new recipes at the relevant lathes. [color=#F97316]Ordnance[/color] is different - its nodes unlock Science-exclusive weapon shops and combat bonuses instead of recipes.
